visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a blurred, out-of-focus shot of a large red and yellow billboard for a temple market, set against a bright blue sky. A main character, a man in a white t-shirt and black-rimmed glasses, is seen from behind using a large mallet to strike a "King of the Hill" strength-testing game machine at an outdoor fair. Yellow variety text overlays appear on the screen. (2) The scene cuts to a food stall selling "Big Hot Dogs" with yellow and red signage. The main character takes a large bite of a fried hot dog on a stick, his eyes closed in enjoyment. The background is a busy outdoor market with many people and colorful stall tents under a clear, sunny sky. (3) The creator displays a clear plastic container of fried taro balls in shades of yellow and purple. He points to them with his finger and then eats one, gesturing with his hand and nodding to indicate high quality. The camera uses a medium close-up shot, capturing his facial expressions clearly amidst the crowded market background. (4) A transition leads to a "Crispy Pork" stall where a male vendor is seen slicing pork on a griddle. The creator, now accompanied by a friend in a black baseball cap, discusses the food prices. He eats a slice of pork served in a small box with raw onions, looking impressed by the texture. Bright daylight illuminates the bustling urban street scene. (5) The shot changes to a beef offal stall, marked by a brown sign with white text. A long line of customers is visible in the background. The creator eats a large bowl of beef offal with noodles and soup using a plastic fork, showing a close-up of the food's ingredients including meat and pickled vegetables. (6) A rapid montage showcases various food items: an egg pancake being cooked on a flat top, skewers of grilled pork butts, rows of sausages on a large circular grill, and a variety of packaged snacks at a large stall. The lighting begins to shift towards the golden hour of evening, with warm tones on the surrounding structures. (7) As night falls, the creator is seen drinking a bottle of yellow sugarcane juice. The background features a brightly lit scale model of the Eiffel Tower and a glowing carousel with a golden horse statue on top. He speaks directly to the camera with a joyful expression, surrounded by families and children enjoying the amusement park atmosphere.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 北台灣. (2) [Variety]: 最大北台灣夜市 GO GO!. (3) [Subtitle]: 黃底紅字的熱狗攤 看看那金黃色的麵糰 裹在粉紅色的熱狗上 瞬間將我拉回 童年回憶. (4) [Subtitle]: 第二家 他將芋圓球 以糖葫蘆的形式呈現 外殼那極脆的糖衣 才是精華. (5) [Subtitle]: 下一間 脆皮豬 脆皮豬喔 哎很貴哎 我買不起～ 好那我買給你吃. (6) [Subtitle]: 他那烤到爆皮的外衣 口感相當酥脆 跟讓我驚訝的是那軟嫩的口感 堪稱完美. (7) [Subtitle]: 這家牛雜也是必吃 他那燉到軟爛的口感 加上微微中藥湯頭 再搭配上 酸菜跟辣椒 每一口都讓你 回味無窮 太好哭了. (8) [Variety]: 賣屁股. (9) [Subtitle]: 看到這種有香氣的 也要買來品嚐一下 還有這種零食攤 也太強了吧 因為天氣太熱 買杯退火的來喝 在夜市的頭尾都有 各種遊樂設施 感覺小朋友來 一定會玩瘋 我覺得這個地方 很適合小朋友 家庭旅遊來. (10) [Slogan]: 你來過了嗎？ 聽說年底就沒囉！

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track initiates with a punchy, high-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring a strong rhythmic four-on-the-floor beat. A loud, percussive "thud" sound of a mallet hitting a mechanical game machine is heard at the very start. The main male narrator begins speaking in a high-arousal, energetic, and professional tone, welcoming viewers to the market. The background is filled with the ambient chatter of a large crowd and distant carnival noises. (2) The narrator's voice transitions to a descriptive, appreciative tone as he discusses various foods. Clear, crisp sound effects of biting and chewing are layered over the music, synchronized with visual eating actions. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume, providing a steady energetic floor. Occasional sharp "pop" sounds or digital UI sound effects mark transitions between different segments. (3) A distinct shift occurs as natural dialogue is heard between the main narrator and a second male voice. The friend's voice is casual and slightly teasing, while the narrator responds with humor. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the conversational speech to remain clear. The ambient noise floor includes the sizzle of food on a grill and the clinking of utensils. (4) In the final phase, the audio captures the distinctive mechanical whirring and bell-like "ding" sounds of amusement park rides. The narrator speaks with a warm, satisfied tone, his speech rate moderate and clearly enunciated as he concludes the review. The BGM swells for a high-energy finish as the carnival atmosphere dominates the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and review the attractions and food stalls at a large temporary night market in Northern Taiwan, encouraging viewers to visit before it closes.
